reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the foil sachets and the 'Every batch lab-tested' line with a QR code. Single-use foil packets feel wasteful, and a brand with zero reviews is a pass for me, because I read the 1-star reviews first and there are none to read.
objection: No reviews at all, so I can't check complaints about stomach upset, capsule size or whether the dosing is real. A QR code is the brand's own claim, not other buyers telling me what happened. Foil packets for every single dose is a lot of trash.
would_change_my_mind: Several hundred verified reviews with the 1-star ones showing no stomach or dosing complaints, plus a regular bottle or refill option without individual foil packets.
